proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly lists Sindhi gharavāro husband and Hindi gharwālā householder/husband, gharwālī wife under *gharapāla house-guardian. These complete survey formations preserve both the house base and the vāl-/vāḷ- member, with gender and local gh/k/b/w correspondences retained. The link is to the already analysed historical compound, not a partial house-only etymology; heavily contracted gharālā/kɛrɛlā and mixed responses are excluded.
